mapper.sql: r.id AS `cursor`, r.id AS orderId, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.member_id AS memberId, r.quote_id AS quoteId, r.merchant_no AS merchantNo, r.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, r.status AS status, r.financial_status AS financialStatus, r.payable_amount AS payableAmount, r.currency AS currency, r.expires_at AS expiresAt, r.paid_at AS paidAt, r.completed_at AS completedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.version AS version, r.payment_started_at AS paymentStartedAt, r.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS itemId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.sku_revision AS skuRevision, i.title AS title, i.specification AS specification, i.stock_type AS stockType, i.quantity AS quantity, i.unit_price AS unitPrice, i.payable_amount AS payableAmount, i.returned_quantity AS returnedQuantity FROM tc_order_item i WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND i.order_id=#{number} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT f.fulfillment_no AS fulfillmentNo, f.delivered_at AS deliveredAt, f.completed_at AS completedAt, f.version AS version FROM tc_order_fulfillment f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND f.order_id=#{number}
